summary: ORIX Corporation filed a Form 6-K on September 3, 2026, reporting its monthly share repurchase status. The company repurchased 5,667,000 common shares for JPY 35,637,406,000 (~JPY 6,288/share) from August 1–31, 2026, under a board-approved program announced May 11, 2026, authorizing up to 100,000,000 shares (≈9.1% of outstanding) and JPY 250 billion through March 31, 2027. Cumulative purchases reached 18,052,000 shares (JPY 114,085,732,300). Purchases are open-market via discretionary dealing contracts. No advisors, premium, or close date apply; watch execution pace versus the approved ceiling.
